title: Bountiful Redux
body:
![Logo](https://i.imgur.com/eKIfz6R.png) ### **This modpack requires OptiFine** [![Download OptiFine](https://img.shields.io/badge/download-OPTIFINE-red?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=gray)](https://optifine.net/adloadx?f=OptiFine_1.8.9_HD_U_L5.jar&x=f0ee)

![Screenshot](https://i.imgur.com/vblqmiu.png) > *More bountiful than ever* **Bountiful Redux** is a modpack designed to improve your Minecraft 1.8 experience (The _Bountiful_ Update). It's perfect for those who enjoy the 1.8 combat system, but want some **new features, backports and QOL improvements** for a more satisfying playthrough. _This is my first modpack so a follow is always appreciated :)_ # ✦ Features - Keystrokes - Free world hosting - Downloading worlds and packs in-game - More new mob variants - Advanced particle customization - Recording and replaying - Minimap and world map - Glowing effect - Modern F3 features - Command autocompletion - Backported mob variants - More languages - Backported sounds - Backported textures - 3D modelled skin layers - Keybinds search bar - Scrollable tooltips - Crafting recipe viewer - Zooming - Text replacing # ✦ _Bountiful Guide_
Mod menu

• Use right shift while in game to open the OneConfig mod menu.

• Click on the blue mod names to turn mods on or off. Click on the icons to change mod settings.



• Click on "Edit HUD" in the bottom-left corner of the menu to move HUD elements.
Downloading worlds

• Click on the + button in the top right of the world list to open the world downloader.



• Click on any world and then the "Install" button to download it.
Recording and replaying

• Press Esc and click on "Start recording" or "Stop recording" while in game to start or finish recording.



• Exit the game and wait for your replay to save.



• Click on "Replay Viewer" in the main menu to watch and manage your replays.
Free world hosting

• Press Esc and click on "Open to LAN" to open your world to other players.



• Wait for a temporary IP to appear in chat. As long as you're online, other players can use the IP to join your world.
Resource pack customization

• Press Esc, then go into "Options" and then "Resource Packs" to customize resource packs.



• Make sure the pack "Backport Everything" is always at the very bottom of the list to avoid texture glitches.
# ✦ Included mods and resource packs _All of the mods and resource packs in this pack come directly from the Modrinth website._ Most resource packs in this modpack will not work unless OptiFine is installed, get the right version [here](https://optifine.net/adloadx?f=OptiFine_1.8.9_HD_U_L5.jar&x=f0ee) and drag it into your 'mods' folder.
